bullets.title: ORCL: Blowout Q1 with $30B AI Bookings; Ellison Cancels Stock Sale Plan
bullets.body: Oracle's F1Q27 delivered cloud revenue up 121% YoY to $7.4B (IaaS +121%) with RPO surging to $664B (+46% YoY) after booking $30B+ of new AI cloud contracts; capex guidance maintained at $90-95B. Management added 850MW capacity in the quarter (triple Q4). Separately, Larry Ellison cancelled his 10b5-1 stock sale plan, signaling personal confidence in the trajectory. Most sell-side remains bullish: Wells Fargo $280 OW, KeyBanc $300 OW, JPM reiterates OW at $200, Citi Buy at $330; RBC lowered PT to $165 Sector Perform.

bullets.title: ADBE: ARR Deceleration Triggers Sharp Sell; Net New ARR Down 39% YoY
bullets.body: Adobe's Q3 showed revenue and EPS slight beats but net new ARR collapsed 39% YoY to $400M (vs $660M prior year) and RPO growth decelerated to 8% — the first sub-10% reading since Q4 FY22. Q4 revenue guide of $6.80-6.85B missed consensus. Hedgeye maintains top short thesis, calling Q4 beat requirement of 1.94x step-up 'unprecedented.' Analyst ratings diverge: JPM OW with PT cut to $315; Citi cuts PT to $250; Wells Fargo raises PT to $270; Hedgeye remains short. AI-first ARR exceeded $650M (+150% YoY) but monetization trails user acquisition.

bullets.title: META: Upgraded to OW at JPM ($820 PT) on Muse AI Agent; Usage 10x vs Test Cohorts
bullets.body: JPMorgan upgraded META to Overweight from Neutral, raising PT to $820 (23x 2028E GAAP EPS $35.44), citing the Muse personal AI agent launching with early usage running 10x above testing cohorts and reaching #2-4 on the iOS App Store. Meta's 4B+ user distribution and privacy-focused architecture viewed as key competitive moat. Wells Fargo also upgraded to OW (PT $820). META +6.6% on week. Watermelon (next-gen model) expected in October as next major catalyst.

bullets.title: SHOP: Bernstein Initiates Outperform ($160 PT); Mizuho Bullish on Muse Integration
bullets.body: Bernstein initiated SHOP at Outperform with a $160 PT (26% upside), helping shares rally +3.5% on the week. Separately, Mizuho maintains Outperform on SHOP, arguing Meta Muse disintermediation fears are overblown — Muse uses Stripe Link but routes payments normally through Shop Pay, with native integration coming soon. JPM also reiterates OW at $185 PT, calling SHOP the 'leading agentic commerce platform' with new buyers from AI sources converting at 2x the rate of traditional channels.

bullets.title: NVDA: DOJ Investigating Groq Licensing Deal; Anthropic IPO Anchor Role Explored
bullets.body: NVDA fell -5.2% on the week on reports the Justice Department is investigating Nvidia's Groq licensing deal for potential antitrust structuring concerns. On the positive side, Nvidia is reportedly in talks to invest up to $10B as anchor investor in Anthropic's upcoming IPO at a $2T valuation. Jensen Huang reiterated 70% revenue growth guidance for 2027. MSFT plans to triple data center capacity to 38GW by 2032 — a strong demand signal for NVDA's compute ecosystem.

bullets.title: AMD: Data Center to More Than Double in 2027; MI450 Ramps Q3 with CPU +80% H2
bullets.body: AMD at Goldman Sachs Communacopia and Citi TMT conferences reiterated data center revenue will more than double in 2027, with MI450 GPU ramp starting Q3 with significant step-up in Q4 and Q1'27. Server CPU supply growing 80% in H2'26 and 70% in '27 despite constraints. AMD also announced collaboration with Xanadu on Backline for quantum-classical computing. Citi maintains Buy at $575 PT (16.5% upside). Server CPU TAM revised to $220B by 2030 on agentic AI adoption.

bullets.title: RH: Strong Q2 Beat on Margins; Revenue Set to Accelerate Sharply in 4Q on Estates
bullets.body: RH reported Q2 gross margin of 48.2% (vs consensus 43.3%) and EBITDA margin 19.4% (vs Street 12.8%), driven by tariff refunds and margin outperformance. FY26 guidance raised to +5.5-7% revenue growth. Q4 guide of +16.1-21.2% revenue is the key catalyst, with RH Estates contributing +8.0 points. Morgan Stanley maintains Overweight at $210 PT (47% upside). UBS stays Neutral at $154 PT, noting 4Q is unproven at scale. Stock +7% after-hours on earnings.

bullets.title: GLW: Verizon Multi-Billion Fiber Deal Accelerates $20B Revenue Target to 3Q
bullets.body: Corning and Verizon signed a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar supply agreement for 80M+ miles of high-density optical fiber through 2032. The deal — alongside prior Lumen and Zayo LTAs — enables Corning to pull forward its $20B run-rate target by one quarter (to 3Q). GLW surged ~12% on the week. Citi Buy at $220 PT (43% upside); China Renaissance initiates Buy at $238. DCI business targeting $1B revenue by decade-end; 4Q sales expected to exceed 3Q with high-teens YoY growth.

bullets.title: ANET: Raised 2026 Revenue Guidance to $12.6B (+40%); AI Scale-Up Revenue in 2028
bullets.body: Arista at the Citi TMT conference raised 2026 revenue guidance to ~$12.6B representing ~40% growth. Purchase commitments tripled to $9.6B over three quarters. Scale-across deployments now ~1/3 of AI sales with room to expand; scale-up revenue excluded from 2026 guidance, with pilots expected in 2027 and commercial revenue in 2028. Supply secured through 2027 on semiconductors and memory. Citi maintains Buy at $215 PT. XPO deployments begin 2H'27 with broader adoption 2028.

bullets.title: AVGO: Reaffirms $115B FY27 / $230B FY28 AI Revenue Targets; Custom Silicon Rising
bullets.body: Broadcom at Goldman Sachs Communacopia reaffirmed AI infrastructure revenue doubling to ~$115B in FY27 and ~$230B in FY28. XPV partnership funds 20+GW compute; supply is the binding constraint, not chip supply. Custom ASICs expected to rise from 34% to 66% of incremental AI compute capacity by 2028. AVGO secured long-duration custom silicon relationships with Google (through 2031) and OpenAI. Wolfe webcast flagging AVGO earnings as upcoming catalyst.

bullets.title: TSLA: MS Raises Bull Case to $840 on Autonomous Trucking ($0.5-1.1tn TAM by 2041)
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raised TSLA bull case PT to $840 from $821, adding $20/share from Tesla Semi autonomous software. TAM estimated at $0.5-1.1tn in US by 2041; autonomous fleet 6-8x more profitable than human-driven. Semi autonomy could generate $12-18K/month in software revenue per truck vs ~$100/month for consumer FSD. MS maintains base case Equal-Weight at $400. Hedgeye Risk Range shifted TSLA from Bullish to Bearish on 9/10.

bullets.title: PLTR: DA Davidson Upgrades to Buy ($250 PT) on AI Sovereignty Positioning
bullets.body: DA Davidson raised PLTR PT from $200 to $250 and upgraded to Buy, citing growing institutional investor interest following AIPCon11 focused on AI sovereignty and a supply management system built for NVIDIA leveraging Nemotron. PLTR UBS hosting update call Sept 15 post-customer and leadership event. Long-term thesis: data management, security, governance, and enterprise optimization beyond the AI trade.

bullets.title: HOOD: Upgraded to Outperform at Mizuho ($140 PT) on AI IPO Boost; $0.50 Options Fee
bullets.body: Mizuho upgraded Robinhood to Outperform, raising PT to $140 from $130. Thesis: anticipated AI IPOs in Oct 2026 and 2027 could produce 24-38% trading volume uplift similar to June's SpaceX IPO effect (+24% equity volumes, +38% options). Robinhood added ~1M funded customers in Q2 — largest quarterly gain in nearly 5 years. Morgan Stanley also raised PT to $150 (OW). Separately, HOOD will charge $0.50/contract for professional options orders effective Oct 15.

bullets.title: CRM: Dreamforce Previews Claudeforce Partnership; Agentforce ARR at $1.5B and Growing
bullets.body: Wolfe's Communacopia TMT recap flagged CRM as a conference standout with the Claudeforce/Anthropic partnership launching 37 prebuilt Agentforce skills. Agentforce ARR reached $1.5B in F2Q27 (up $300M sequentially), with Data+Agentforce ARR combined at $3.9B (+200% YoY). JPM reiterates OW at $265 PT, expecting Dreamforce to confirm double-digit FY28 subscription growth and >$5B AI ARR exit in FY27. Salesforce also completing acquisition of Fin for ~$3.6B.

bullets.title: CIEN: $10B+ Backlog, Guides 30%+ FY27 Revenue Growth; Supply-Constrained to 2027
bullets.body: Ciena at JPM's Rising Tech Leaders Forum disclosed backlog expected to exceed $10B at FY26 exit with supply-constrained guidance of at least 30% YoY revenue growth in FY27. Scale-across deployments early innings with ~50-70% baseline position. Inside data center TAM expected ~$10B vs total TAM ~$50B by end of decade. Gross margin targets 45% with multiple levers including long-term pricing agreements. Wolfe names CIEN as one of four top networking/optics picks for AI datacenter demand.

bullets.title: MDB: Bullish on AI Inflection; Atlas Traffic Higher Post-MCP Rollout; Investor Day 9/29
bullets.body: MongoDB CEO at Citi TMT conference highlighted growth curve bending as customer-facing agents scale beyond internal use cases. Managed MCP integrations for Claude, Codex, and Grok drove higher Atlas traffic within 3.5 weeks of Aug 13 launch. AI-native and frontier labs adopting MDB for document model agility and multi-cloud. Goldman Sachs maintains Buy with $520 PT, noting vector search expansion as next growth catalyst. Investor Day scheduled Sept 29.

bullets.title: SNDK: Structural NAND Demand Shift to AI Datacenters; Mid-to-High Teens Bit Growth
bullets.body: Sandisk CFO at Citi TMT conference described NAND entering a structurally stronger demand environment driven by AI inference and data lakes. Two key NBM customers returned with one adding significant volume; HBF consortium (Hynix, Meta, Google) sampling expected in 2027. Mobile could see low-single-digit growth in 2027 as mid-high end phones increase storage content. Industry and company bit growth expected mid-to-high teens annually from node transitions and productivity gains.

bullets.title: HUBS: KeyBanc OW ($285 PT); Agent Builder Lacks Pricing Clarity Ahead of Dreamforce
bullets.body: KeyBanc previews Dreamforce and HubSpot Unbound with a cautious near-term view: HubSpot Agent Builder (launched July) lacks transparent credit usage predictability, causing adoption hesitancy. Agentforce ARR decelerated from $400M to $300M sequentially. KeyBanc rates HUBS Overweight at $285 PT based on 14.8x EV/FCFF. Upcoming analyst days for INTU and HUBS are near-term catalysts flagged in the Wolfe weekly.

bullets.title: DKNG: Early NFL Acquisition Pace Determines Predictions EBITDA Timing
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy on DraftKings; Predictions EBITDA timing hinges on early NFL season customer acquisition. Optimistic scenario (aggressive acquisition) → strong 2027 EBITDA; gradual scenario mirrors state OSB rollout with 2028 harvest. DraftKings' DKX proprietary exchange processed opening-night NFL volume, retaining greater transaction economics. NY OSB GGR +47% YoY in week ending 9/6 despite handle down 8%; DKNG GGR grew 270% YoY for the week with share at 35%.

bullets.title: HIMS: JPM Initiates Neutral ($32 PT); Pivoting to Branded GLP-1s via Novo Partnership
bullets.body: JPMorgan initiates HIMS at Neutral with $32 PT (Dec 2027), citing the company's pivot from compounded to branded FDA-approved GLP-1s with Novo Wegovy partnership showing 125K+ shipments in 6 weeks. HIMS projects 2026E GLP-1 revenue of $1.1B (+46% YoY). 2026E guidance of $3.1-3.3B revenue (+36% YoY); targeting $6.5B revenue and $1.3B EBITDA by 2030. Hedgeye flagged HIMS peptide bull/bear case as under review.
